meta.name: Chakka
meta.description: Ork Power, with no privilege, and a whole lot of fuckin' rage.
meta.background: Chakka drew his first breath in a kaer that was meant to keep its people safe — until slavers cracked it open and dragged them into the light. Torn from his family before he was old enough to hold their faces in memory, he was shackled aboard a Theran airship and sold into slavery. For two years he laboured under a Theran dwarf, swallowing his rage and biding his time. When fate finally left the door to freedom unguarded, Chakka threw himself through it with everything he had — and he has never once looked back.

earned.description: After completing the Horror Prison story line Chakka was able to reflect on the whole situation and make changes in his path

traits.name: Gahad trigger
traits.description: Comes from the Dwarf that had Chakka captured for two years on the airship. The slaver was very proud of the whip, and even more happy when he used it on the larger Orks.

notes.text:
Save Kolons' Sister:
We return to Urupa and gather the team to fly to the Killa encampment, where Lord Crind resides, and Kollon's sister is his slave.
We fly out of Urupa and land in the woods some 30 miles from the front lines.

Theran Encampment:
We start the journey on foot and head through the forest, where we cross paths with a small dwarven party.  
A fight starts, but it's over quickly, as these dwarfs are low-level army personnel. Kolon captures one of the remaining dwarves and starts to interrogate him. 
We discover that the party he is from is 3rd armed force under the command of lord cornelius of the theran empire. The dwarf does not live through the interogation, and neither of us morn the loss.

Family Details:
3 sisters, 1 brother & 1 uncle.  Parents did not survive the opening of the Kear.

SISTERS:
- Eldest : Brakka known for her strength and fierce loyolty.  She was sold to teh AJXIA house and transported to Thera Island
- Middle : Morga who is clever and sharp-tongued, surviving through cunning.  sold to House FARTHGO, unknown localation as the house is no longer
- Youngest : Zinsha - the quiet sister, but the most capable killer.  Sold to a Trader in Criana

BROTHER:
- Druggan - Fiercely loyal yet often reckless, Druggan lives in the shadow of his elder brother.  Escaped capture and last seen in Travar

UNCLE: 
Broot - he is an iron smith, has a name is slightly famous but owned by house Daneppa - Workhouse on the Theran Island.

TRAINER:
Hujo - is the Orc that initial taught me archery, working as a slave in the Theran killa Triuph

Monks of Niecia agreements:
Discovered during the Horror Prision Raid.
- We have been given materials and secrets to building the portal at Zeta Prime.
- We are Trading excess food and material for credit and coin. 
- We can request travel through their numerous portals

We also have an agreemenet on:
If we need help with a Horror or capture a horror we can work with them

THE GAP:
The wall city on the road to Parlanth, unofficially guarded to keep anything from Parlanth from going any further south.
Group we meet protecting the gate: 
-  Axelandretta might be an elementist elf looks to be a leader
- Aduka the female horror hunter
- Kaloc the weapon smith
- Urri the drunk thief

history.text: Escaped Slavery:  On a Theran Airship "Hellenian" that opened our Kear and took us a saves.  After two years of slavery a heavvy storm and some fortune crashed the airship and we were free, after taking some vengence on our Therian captures.

Dun Morro: Lost in the mountains of Throal after the crash we gather the other survivers and start to walk out.  We stumbled apon what we thought was an old abanded town, but found more Theran scum and after some fighting freed the town of their infulence.
New Airship (Shadow Moon): We discover an old airship in teh town and claim it for ourselves. the 11 of us go about making it ready for flight and freedom.

To THROAL:  We have capture the captain of the Threans in Dunn Moror and plan to fly to Throal and sell him there.  The flighth across the mountain is interupted by Gargoyles, but we take care of them can continue on.
THROAL Royalty:  We arrive at Throal and a dutches requests our audiance after learning about our capture and Dunn Morro.  The meeting goes so well that she offer us a 3 year letter of Mark.
CARRAFAD road:  The local Orc hear about use and we are invited to the main Orc area of Carrafad road.  We are treated as hero and get messed up.
SUPPORT request: As a show of support we are asked to do a petrol run for Throal.  On the petrol we find an abandoned site and collect the resources for Throal
MARREK: After returning with the resources to Throal we again meet with the Dutches.  She provides information about possible abandoned towns in the Tskrangian area of the Serpent river
ANOTHER INVITE: No real potential at Marrek, so head to a small Tskrang village down river and get informed that the Queen of Syrtis wants to see us.
VISITING a TSKRANG QUEEN: In the meeting with Tskrang queen get informed of prime locations to claim for ourselves. Reason why queen wants this is to stabilise the area.

ABDUCTED: We go to a bar to celebrate and get spotted by a human that recognises us as famous.  Offers to buy us drinks and we never refuse free ale.  Next thing we know we are passing out.
Never trust a human at a bar that offers free drinks again.

SECOND THERIAN AIRSHIP: The human at the bar in Cliff city is a bounty hunter for the Therian's and we awake in cells.  We break free, fight our way to the top deck and kill most of the crew in a fit of anger and frustration.  This causes the ship to crash. We survive the crash, 2nd in a year and free the surviving slaves.

THE GAP: We have crash landed in a place south of Parlanth called the Gap.  Meet the guards that are stationed here, they protect the road leading from Parlanth ensuring the evil spreads no further. 
They help us out and in return we agree to help them retrieve a friend of theirs that has not returned from a patrol.

ROAD TO PARLANTH: To get the missing friend (Urri) we need to travel the road to Parlanth, until we reach a place where an underground tavern exists.  We find the Tavern, find Urri and head back to the Gap

THERIAN's TAKE THE GAP: As we approach the Gap we see that Therians have taken it from our new friends, and we can not resist and attack the group at the gate.
Winning that fight we head in to the old city to see the main force and plan an attack

FLOODING OF THE GAP: We start our battle with the main force and unknown to us the return of Parlanth has triggered a tsunami that is fast approaching.  The Therians start running but we see that the wave can not be out-runned.  We instead choose a taller build and climb to ride out the wave.  It hits and takes out most of the building including ours but we manage to hold on and ride out the worst of the disaster.

The Therians are wiped out so all is good in the world again.

LONG ROAD HOME: After all the miss adventures the core team decides to go back to Zeta Prima and see is the main group got their after our abdunction.  We add some new people to the group and plot a course back that covers the steps we took to get to where we are now.

HORROR's HAVE PRISIONS TOO: On the journey back we come across what looks like a Kear and investigate.  We soon work out that it is a prison designed for Horrors, and to make things worse, some are still here in their cells.
Kolon and Aduka can not resist checking out the cells and we start a bloody encounter with a giant horror construct spider.

WHERE IS OUR AIRSHIP: We leave the prison as the first encounter showed us that we are not prepared enough for this.
We agree to go back to the city (The Tskrang Cliff City of Lalai Gorge) and see if our ship and crew are still there.  So we start on the long walk across the mountain range.

CLIFF CITY TAKE 2: We return to Cliff City looking for our ship and crew and find another ship carrying our flag??
We find Pappa on board and he informs us that in the 14 days we have been missing, Merrek where we last left for the search of a new Ork city, now has many free Ork's looking for a chance at a fresh start.

TAKE ZETA PRIME: We get to Zeta Prime the team offloads from the airship and sends it back for more Orks. We then encounter some Cadaver that we quickly take care of.  

We are then met by a Dragon Kind ambassador, Cuvicar, that explains that we are welcome to the locations and that his master welcomes re-settlement, but that he must first take care of a Horror situation....

CLEAR THE PAST: We start to clear out the city but it has been dead for a long time.  We find signs that some Dwarfs did remain but a Horror did live here and died off collecting all that it could before it died.

VISIT BY A PASSION: When we return to the outside of the City we feel time slow down and 2 figures are approaching us.
These mysterious figures are 2 Passions,  Mynbruje and Dis.

They approach us and try to strike bargains, we side with Mynbruje and Dis leaves...
TRAINING DAY: After all that, Kolon and I need to train and circle up.  He goes off to find a Warior to train in a new discipline and I continue in advancing in Archer.

THE THROAL COURT: We land in the port of Throal and make our way to the Duchess.  There we are encouraged to take on titles as they will legitimise our claim of a new free city for Orks.  But Kolon tells the court that we are not interested and that they can keep their titles.  That is when the King makes a showing and takes us aside.  

He is only interested in our stories and allows us to continue as we are but asks that next time when we return that we are to see him first and not the duchess.

SHOPPING: The Eclipse recruits some families to migrate to our new settlement and also some adventurers to come with us to the horror prison.
We also gear up with some impressive threadable items (novice level) and prepare for the flight back home to drop of the civilians and then continue to the horror prision.

SUPPLY & RUN: We take off to Zeta Prime with supplies and the extra Orc adventurers.  The flight to Zeta Prime is unaventful, we land, unload the supplies and head off to the horror Prision with more talent, more equipement and more people.

HORROR PRISION TAKE2: When we arrive at the horror prison we find that it has been recently visited by Therin's.  The remains of their carriages and supplies are left outside the Kear along with the dead that were attacked and killed by some horror construct of a spider.  We we approach to investigate the spider attacks but Kolon makes easy work of it.

THERIAN Stuff: The supplies that have been left behind include some potions and food, so we secure them in them and transfer to the Air Ship and continue into the Kear.  There we encounter a spirit horror of a little girl and I take her down in one shot using my new Ork Stinger firing the double bolt.

HORRORS EVERYWHERE: We continue further in to the prision and find cells, one had another giant spider which is taken care of.  One cell we can hear someone inside but the door is jamed.  After opening it we find what looks like one of teh Therian's that has been changed into a construct.  He is prone and asking if we have come to free him.  Chakka and the other Archer answer with their arrows ending his suffering.

LET IT SLEEP: We open the last remaining cell door and see a decaying body in a chain, just to make sure I shoot it and that reviels just how old the body is as it starts to crumble.  The wizard in the party steps up and starts to investigate finding runes that suggest that what ever this is, the astral part of it is trapped. So we let sleeping dogs lie.

KEEP GOING: We agree to continue further into the prision and possible treasure when we discover a mechanical door that has been forced open.  Inside is a spherical room with three Therians floating near the ceiling.  We uncove the fact that the room is trapped and that the Therians, although alive, have all been marked.  After a quick conversation its clear they have been here a few days and have been abanded by their group, so we do the same and continue.

TAKE IT ALL APART: We continue further in to the prision and come across another warded door with complicated locking and magical wards.  Kolon steps up and works his magic and after a few hours the door is not only opened but completely taken apart.

CHAMBER OF DOORS: we continue in to the prison and find ourselves in a large open camber, larger than any grand hall we have ever seen, with many arches across all the walls.  The arches on the wall are very well constructed and carved with runes.

THERIAN CAMP: As we progress further in we find a large room that has been set up with tents and cretes.  In the far corner we see large goats in a makeshift pen, this has all the signs of a Therian camp.  We look through and find that it has supplies for a lonf stay so we assume this is the base camp, but it seems that this has been appandend for some time so what has become of the Therian?

PORTALS ACROSS BARSAVE: We start to investigate the arches when one seems to magically activate and we see a landscape of a swamp with one person back to the portal sitting on a log in front of a small camp fire.  We can not make sense of what we are seeing, is this a window to an actual place, or a portal to travel, and is this location still Barsave.

PLAN A TRIP
After some discussion Kolon wanys to go through the portal and try and get some answers from the figure on the otherside.  I disagree but there is no stoipping Kolon so we agree on a signal should things go wrong.  Kolon jump through the portal and looks very unsteady on the other side, starts talking to the figure who is very surprised, Kolon then turns and gives us the signal.
